header.title: Dragon Warrior (USA)
header.author: RobOS AI Studio
header.description: Darkness enshrouds the realm of Alefgard after the sinister Dragonlord plundered the sacred Ball of Light. King Loric summons the last descendant of Erdrick to embark on the quest.

robos:storyNodes.dcterms:title: The Royal Decree of Tantegel
robos:storyNodes.robos:summary: King Loric greets the descendant of Erdrick in Tantegel Throne Room. The Ball of Light has been stolen by the Dragonlord, plunging Alefgard into darkness.

robos:choices.label: Take the royal treasure chests and depart for Brecconary Town

robos:storyNodes.dcterms:title: The Town of Brecconary
robos:storyNodes.robos:summary: In Brecconary, townspeople whisper of Princess Gwaelin's abduction and an ancient inscription left by Erdrick concerning the three sacred relics.

robos:choices.label: Descend into the swamp cave to rescue Princess Gwaelin
Seek the sacred relics across Rimuldar and Cantlin first

robos:storyNodes.dcterms:title: The Swamp Cave & The Green Dragon
robos:storyNodes.robos:summary: Deep within the noxious swamp cave, a fierce Green Dragon guards Princess Gwaelin's cage.

robos:choices.label: Slay the Green Dragon, rescue the Princess, and carry her to Tantegel

robos:storyNodes.dcterms:title: The Rainbow Bridge
robos:storyNodes.robos:summary: Combining the Staff of Rain and Sunstone at the sacred shrine creates the Rainbow Drop, spanning a luminous bridge across the sea to Charlock Castle.

robos:choices.label: Cross the Rainbow Bridge into Castle Charlock

robos:storyNodes.dcterms:title: Throne of the Dragonlord
robos:storyNodes.robos:summary: Reaching the infernal throne at the base of Charlock Castle, the Dragonlord sneers: 'Welcome, Erdrick's blood. Will thou join me and rule half the world in shadows?'

robos:choices.label: Refuse the evil bargain! Draw Erdrick's Sword and strike him down
Accept the dark pact and kneel before the Dragonlord
Waver in hesitation as the Dragonlord unleashes searing flames

robos:storyNodes.dcterms:title: Ending A: The Ball of Light & The Royal Wedding
robos:storyNodes.robos:summary: The Dragonlord is vanquished and the Ball of Light banishes all monsters.
robos:storyNodes.robos:epilogueText: Holding high the radiant Ball of Light, sunlight pierces the dark clouds over Alefgard for the first time in an age. King Loric steps down from his throne, and Princess Gwaelin takes your hand in marriage as you set sail to found a prosperous new kingdom across the ocean.

robos:storyNodes.dcterms:title: Ending B: Reign of the Shadow Sovereign
robos:storyNodes.robos:summary: You betray King Loric and rule Alefgard as the Dragonlord's dark champion.
robos:storyNodes.robos:epilogueText: Seduced by promises of absolute dominion, you take the Dragonlord's outstretched claw. Tantegel Castle falls to your combined legions, and Alefgard is carved into two dark realms ruled by terror and draconic flame.

robos:storyNodes.dcterms:title: Ending C: Ashes in Charlock
robos:storyNodes.robos:summary: The descendant of Erdrick falls in the depths of Charlock Castle.
robos:storyNodes.robos:epilogueText: The Dragonlord's infernal breath incinerates the halls of Charlock. With the last hero slain, King Loric watches helplessly from Tantegel as darkness consumes the realm of Alefgard.

Now, Hero, thou must help us recover the Ball of Light and restore peace to our land. The Dragonlord must be defeated.
